app.name: Ekwe
app.description: Record or import voice notes and get instant translations in 130+ languages. Powered by AI, built for everyone.

features.title: Voice Translation
features.description: Record or import voice notes and get accurate translations in 130+ languages.

features.title: AI-Powered
features.description: Seven speech-to-text engines and six translation models with automatic failover for fast, natural results.

features.title: Native Audio Engine
features.description: A custom C++ audio core runs Opus encoding, noise-aware silence detection, and waveform extraction on your device.

features.title: Share Extension
features.description: Translate audio from any messaging app — WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, and more — via the system share sheet.

features.title: History & Playback
features.description: All your translations saved locally. Search, replay, and export anytime.

features.title: Secure & Private
features.description: Your audio is never stored by us. It's processed on the fly and only the resulting text is kept.
